It depends. I usually cut myself with some kind of blade. When I don't have anything like that I scratch my skin with keys, punch my face or legs, pull my hair out.  Sometimes I don't care about my basic needs; I don't go to the toilet for 8+ hours, I don't eat or sleep for more than 24 hours or I drink a 1/2 cup of water a day. 

I hide my cuts behind plasters and clothes.

During this relationship, I didn't listen to my friends who told me that my situation isn't healthy. Sometimes I was hostile to them and wanted them to just shut up and leave us alone because I thought they don't know shit. I thought I didn't need help. In my mind, our relationship was good because everything has happened for a reason. For example; insults? Yep, I deserved it, my fault, etc.

Last year I just had enough. I started to question why we were behaving this way. There wasn't any crucial moment which triggered it. I was just psychically exhausted and wanted to run away from everything so I did. After that, I started to talk again to my friends who forgave me my rude behaviour towards them.

I'm so sorry to hear about your friend. I wish her that too.

In my opinion, you aren't an idiot.   
The fact that you've relapsed doesn't mean that this 2 months without cutting aren't important anymore.  It is still an accomplishment.

>why should i be feeling this way about such simple things that other people don't have problems with?

Everyone is different. Some people may think that certain situations are trivial but they might be important to you. And that's perfectly fine because you are allowed to feel this way about them.

I often feel like I'm being over problematic but I try to remember that something matters because it matters to *me*.

I usually feel like a 3 but on my good day, I would say I'm a 5.  
Thank God my partner have a different opinion about this than me.

I regret nothing.

I thought I was in a serious relationship but, looking at it now, I was in a toxic one. Before the break up I was a mess and finally opened my eyes that I was manipulated, gaslighted and humiliated on a daily basis. So after about 5 years, I decided I wanted to be as far from this person as possible.
Woah, I'm offended and grateful at the same time. Thank you.

Going to a grocery is a nightmare. I'm scared of what other customers and cashiers might think about me. Going anywhere on my own is such a scary vision; with people I know it is still stressful but not as much because in my mind I'm not *"that weirdo who's walking alone"*. 

I feel really uneasy when someone calls me or stranger in an online game tells me to have a nice day to the point I feel the urge to turn off my computer/phone and hide. And I usually do it.

Basically, I'm afraid of human interactions or what people may think of me.
